k.v: देविकायां सरय्वां च भवे दाविकसारवौ। सौगन्धिकं तु कल्हारं हल्लकं रक्तसंध्यकम्.।

m: कल्हण m. (also spelt कह्लण), N. of the author of the Rāja-taraṃgiṇī.
a: कल्हण — The author of the well-known राजतरंगिणी ‘the chronicle of kings’. He was a {{contemporay->contemporary||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}} of Jayasimha of Kāshmir who reigned from 1129-1150 A. D.

m: कल्होडी-गङ्गेश्वरतीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha.
